sets.name: After Hours
sets.description: First researched set: dark editorial event listings.
sets.preference_source: User explicitly said they really liked options two and three.
sets.status: Reference set retained; no implementation selected.

sets.name: Open Air
sets.description: Second exploration: intentionally different from the dark set, with new layout structures, color systems and print-derived inspiration.
sets.status: Reference set retained; preferred option 2; no implementation selected.
sets.preference_source: User much prefers Open Air option 2.

sets.name: Side Channel
sets.description: Third exploration: interfaces inspired by objects and systems rather than editorial cards or printed tickets.
sets.status: Rejected as a set; retained for reference.
sets.feedback: User is not a fan of any Side Channel option. The designs stayed in the same lane. Preserve big cards, but change composition radically.

sets.name: Off Script
sets.description: Fourth set: radically different large-card compositions; avoid title-photo-metadata templates.
sets.status: Preferred directions retained; asset dependence needs revision.
sets.feedback: User likes 1 and 3 mainly for headers; strongly likes extra-large cards. Concern: styling depends on polished user-provided imagery. Next set must be repeatable with ordinary submitted event details and site-owned patterns.

sets.name: House Rules
sets.description: Fifth set: extra-large cards with site-owned reproducible graphic systems and real text.
sets.status: Not selected; revise toward quiet dark surfaces and richer content.
sets.feedback: Too bright and bold. Repeated event-title text feels forced and is rejected. Wants restrained dark panels, subtle dot/grain textures and more useful event details to justify large cards.

sets.name: Low Light
sets.description: Sixth set: restrained dark panels, subtle surface texture, information-rich large cards without user imagery.
sets.status: Preferred option 1 retained; next exploration deliberately diverges.
sets.feedback: User prefers Low Light 1 but wants research reset and concepts unlike any prior set. Card may be half as tall or intermediate size. Do not merely iterate the same visual lane.

sets.name: Crossroads
sets.description: Seventh set: research reset; time-led board, place-led area previews and interactive catalogue index. Intermediate/variable entry heights.
sets.status: Preferred option 1 retained; no implementation selected.
sets.preference_source: User said: in this round, I liked number one the most.

sets.name: Ink & Signal
sets.description: Eighth set: no event grid or repeated cards; inspired by supplied AudioNest black/white, stencil and violet/cyan branding image.
sets.status: Preferred concept 2 retained; refinement needed; no implementation requested.
sets.feedback: User really likes option 2 (The Orbit), wants it retained as the ideal/preferred concept for this set, and says it needs work. Next exploration will use another unrelated screenshot.

sets.name: Little Sun
sets.description: Ninth set: no grid; supplied bird branding translated into branching schedule, feather accordion and single-event reader.
sets.status: Three concepts generated for exploration; awaiting preference; no implementation requested.

sets.name: Pocket Nights
sets.description: Mobile-only favorites adapted to simple full-width event cards and immersive full-viewport submitted-photo detail. Each image pairs list/open state.
sets.status: Option 3 selected for implementation with simplified mobile cards and substantially richer fullscreen event details.
sets.feedback: User prefers option 3. Wants less detail on card and a real browser prototype with native card-to-listing transition. Individual event listing must contain more information than card.

sets.name: Quiet Studies
sets.description: Six subtle static HTML/CSS refinements of Pocket Texture / Ink After Dark. Shared content, original workshop photo and mobile list/opened-event anatomy; deliberate typography, spacing and dark palettes.
sets.status: User prefers this first refinement family over Still Hours. No individual numbered favorite selected.
sets.feedback: User likes the subtle differences in this set and prefers this family overall to Still Hours. Specifically favors the full-screen opened event with richer details below the fold, its font families and its card layout. Latest instruction: avoid editorial fonts; combine this foundation with zero-gap cards and a more prominent date.

sets.name: Still Hours
sets.description: A second dark static HTML/CSS family: warm charcoal, serif-first hierarchy, a date rail, continuous ruled cards and outlined price/action row. Six subtle optical refinements within one distinctive composition.
sets.status: Reviewed by the user; Quiet Studies is preferred overall.
sets.source: Quiet Studies / Ink After Dark concept, with the same event content and workshop photo.
sets.feedback: User likes the absence of gaps between cards and the more prominent dates. Prefers the first family’s card layout, font families and full-screen event composition. Does not tend to like editorial fonts. Requests three hybrids instead of another six.

sets.name: Quiet Assembly
sets.description: Three static hybrids based on Quiet Studies: sans serif typography, zero-gap full-width cards, three prominent-date placements, original full-screen photographed event and richer details below the fold.
sets.status: Date Line selected as the user’s favorite layout overall and the foundation for further iteration.
sets.source: Quiet Studies 01/04/06 for typography and event composition; Still Hours for continuous cards and date prominence.
sets.feedback: User: Date Line is the favorite layout out of everything so far, including all sample cards. Preserve its pixels and essence. Explore additive real-app needs, especially advertisements and a genuinely poor organizer photo, in separate variations.

sets.name: Date Line — In Practice
sets.description: Two additive static studies around the selected Date Line favorite: clearly labelled local-partner advertisements and an intentionally poor organizer photograph. Approved baseline is preserved separately.
sets.status: Completed and browser-reviewed. Date Line remains the favorite; no preference between the new practical studies assumed.
sets.source: Quiet Assembly 01 Date Line, explicitly selected by the user as favorite layout overall.

options.name: Local Partner
options.changes: 144px labelled list ad after event2; separate ad after event introduction below the opening viewport.

options.name: Rough Upload
options.changes: Intentionally bad organizer photo, with unchanged card list and event foreground geometry.

sets.feedback: User says Date Line is their favorite layout out of all previous samples and wants to preserve its pixels and essence. Asked for a couple of variations introducing practical realities, specifically advertisements and a poor organizer image.
sets.latest_feedback: 2026-10-21: These practical studies are progressing nicely; preserve them. User asks what real-world web app needs and useful microinteractions are still missing. No favorite among the practical studies has been selected.

sets.name: Date Line — Continuity
sets.description: An isolated HTML/CSS/vanilla-JavaScript prototype of native bidirectional View Transitions over the selected Date Line design.
sets.status: Completed and browser-reviewed; awaiting user motion preference. Date Line remains the overall favorite.
sets.source: Quiet Assembly 01 Date Line; exact resting list and Ink After Dark opening retained.

options.name: Linked details
options.changes: Surface, title, category, date parts, start time, venue and price use named native snapshots.

options.name: Title only
options.changes: Only the title travels between views; remaining content dissolves.

sets.feedback: User requests a prototype focused on the View Transition API, with title/date/time moving from the card into the individual event and back. Preserve all approved studies.
sets.controls: Slow motion at 2400ms; original or rough organizer photo. Controls live outside the phone.
sets.validation: 390x844 resting list and Ink event are pixel equal to fresh source captures; actual native intermediate frames inspected; Back/Forward/Escape, scroll/focus return, direct links, saved state and direct fallback verified. See design-qa.md for console/tooling and device-test limits.

sets.name: Date Line — Motion Sketches
sets.description: Fast motion-only iteration reusing the existing prototype: Gather, Aperture and Shutter.
sets.status: Browser-reviewed; awaiting user preference. Date Line remains the favorite overall.
sets.feedback: User wants faster iteration focused on a distinctive list-to-event transition using the native View Transition API, with micro feedback animations secondary.
sets.validation: All three native openings/returns pass. List and all three event endpoints are pixel-identical to Date Line at390x844. No new assets or app features.
sets.latest_feedback: User likes the studies and is leaning toward Gather. Explore richer, deliberately exaggerated microinteractions with real web research.

sets.name: Gather, amplified
sets.description: Research-backed rich microinteraction extension of Gather, preserving the resting Date Line layout.
sets.status: New experiment; no intensity preference selected. Prior Gather remains preserved.

sets.name: Date Line UI kit
sets.description: Static foundations, reusable components, nine companion screen/state layouts, and a prioritized coverage map. Returns to the selected Date Line and sets animation exploration aside.
sets.status: First UI kit pass for review. Original Date Line frames and foundation stylesheets preserved byte-for-byte.

sets.name: Date Line Appearance Studies
sets.description: Three complete UI kit skins with identical components, content, typography, spacing, sizing, screens and coverage. Original Date Line kit retained as a comparison.

options.name: Daybreak
options.style: Light, warm white/lilac with plum actions.

sets.status: Tide is the user-selected favorite UI kit appearance. Its callout stripes were removed at the user’s request.

sets.name: Tide Palette Studies
sets.description: Tide favorite retained, all callout stripes removed. Three palette-only variants preserve square corners and complete kit inventory.

options.name: Mist
options.style: Cool light mode with dark teal actions

sets.status: New variations; no replacement favorite chosen.

sets.name: Tide HTML/CSS Kit
sets.description: Official BEM HTML/CSS foundation based on Tide. Fixed geometry/type; semantic OKLCH tokens, three named themes with light/dark modes, system appearance, contrast gate and additive component guide. All eleven screens per mode.
sets.status: Implementation foundation; Tide remains the current favorite. No replacement theme selected.

preferences.general: Leans minimal and dark, but wants broad variety before settling.
preferences.layout: Single-column event list, roughly 768px wide; taller and somewhat wider treatments are allowed.
preferences.imagery: No dependence on user-supplied high-quality imagery. Site-owned repeatable graphics and patterns preferred for this pass.
preferences.interaction: Event summaries open to rich full-screen detail views.
preferences.research: Use inspected real design references and repurpose ideas outside event listings.
preferences.latest: Keep extra-large cards but avoid loud oversized typography, saturated panels and repeated-title decoration. Research quiet dark textured/dotted surfaces. Use additional useful event details to occupy space.
preferences.exploration_reset: Explore fundamentally different organization and interaction concepts. Intermediate/half-height cards allowed. Low Light 1 is a preference, not a constraint to keep every next mockup dark, dotted or large.
preferences.current_constraint: Use the official Tide HTML/CSS kit. Preserve its square geometry and font/spacing/target primitives. Use stable semantic tokens and named themes, each with light/dark modes; no colored left callout stripes. New themes must pass the paired foreground/background contrast gate.
preferences.typography: Prefer the clean sans serif families from Quiet Studies. Avoid editorial/serif fonts. Current candidates are Manrope, DM Sans and Instrument Sans; user has not chosen one individual face.

selected_direction.name: Date Line
selected_direction.preserve: Exact card layout, Manrope typography, spacing, dark tokens, prominent date, full-screen event opening and scrolling details.
selected_direction.next: Use tide-ui-kit as the implementation foundation; extend BEM blocks and semantic tokens according to its guide.

preferences.ui_kit_presentation: User loves the sidebar and zoomed-out kit presentation. Complete kit is the comparison unit; keep the exact inventory and screen coverage consistent across visual variations.
